newsitem.title: KUWAIT: Kuwait-Amman direct air links to restart in July.
newsitem.headline: Kuwait-Amman direct air links to restart in July.

text.p: Kuwait Airways Corp (KAC) and Royal Jordanian Airlines have agreed to resume direct flights between Amman and Kuwait for the first time since the 1990 Iraqi invasion of Kuwait, an official said on Sunday.
The KAC official told the Kuwait News Agency (KUNA) in Amman that the two sides had agreed in talks in Jordan to equally share four flights a week between the two Arab capitals.

Kuwait has yet to restore full diplomatic ties with Jordan which was seen as an Iraq sympathiser during the Gulf crisis. After distancing himself from Iraqi leader Saddam Hussein, Jordan's King Hussein has succeeded in improving ties with other Gulf Arab states including Saudi Arabia.

Kuwait's parliament on Saturday discussed in a closed session the possibility of resuming normal ties with Arab states which appeared to side with Iraq -- a move which enjoys some official backing but appears to lack wide public support.
